issue.title: [AArch64][SVE] Assertion `(VA.getValVT().isScalableVector() || Subtarget->isWindowsArm64EC()) && "Indirect arguments should be scalable on most subtargets"' failed.

patch:
commit 657e8d08f04b1d0bc07b05c17e8749ecf77f884d
Author: Paul Walker <paul.walker@arm.com>
Date:   Wed Dec 24 11:01:36 2025 +0000

    [LLVM][CodeGen][SVE] Fix CCValAssign::Indirect assert to allow all scalable types. (#173372)
    
    Fixes https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project/issues/172420

diff --git a/llvm/lib/Target/AArch64/AArch64ISelLowering.cpp b/llvm/lib/Target/AArch64/AArch64ISelLowering.cpp
index fa6ddab8eca0..30e2a7b890c6 100644
--- a/llvm/lib/Target/AArch64/AArch64ISelLowering.cpp
+++ b/llvm/lib/Target/AArch64/AArch64ISelLowering.cpp
@@ -8671,9 +8671,9 @@ SDValue AArch64TargetLowering::LowerFormalArguments(
         MemVT = VA.getLocVT();
         break;
       case CCValAssign::Indirect:
-        assert((VA.getValVT().isScalableVector() ||
-                Subtarget->isWindowsArm64EC()) &&
-               "Indirect arguments should be scalable on most subtargets");
+        assert(
+            (VA.getValVT().isScalableVT() || Subtarget->isWindowsArm64EC()) &&
+            "Indirect arguments should be scalable on most subtargets");
         MemVT = VA.getLocVT();
         break;
       case CCValAssign::SExt:
